UAObjectType.Description: Aber Futura Connect Xtra: one device with Probe, FUTURA and SPECTRA components and two FunctionalUnits
FUTURA functional unit: capacitance, conductivity, biomass, temperatures, commands and ProgramManager
SPECTRA functional unit: frequency scan and derived values. Stopped, with all functions disabled, if no SPECTRA is installed
SPECTRA module; the component exists statically, empty if no SPECTRA is installed

UAMethod.Description: Starts one of the ProgramTemplates (Zero, ClearZero, CleanPulse, IncrementAutoclaveCount) with the same behaviour as the corresponding command function

Zeroed and scaled biomass reading: (Capacitance - ZeroValue) x BioMassMultiplier, user defined unit. In Cell Culture mode the multiplier 1.0 gives 10^6 viable cells/ml (rule of thumb of the manual: 1 pF/cm = 10^6 cells/ml). CalibrationValues: [0] ZeroValue pF/cm, [1] BioMassMultiplier
Process temperature at the probe

UAVariable.Description: NAMUR NE 107: worst DeviceHealth of all active alarms of Probe, Futura and Spectra
FUTURA Status Flags register: bits 0-4 warnings, 6-7 errors, 9-10 indicators, 12 curve fit error (SPECTRA); the alarms of DeviceHealthAlarms are derived from the bits

UAObject.Description: One alarm per status bit of the StatusFlags register; the alarm source is the affected component (Probe, Futura or Spectra)
Status bit 2: temperature out of range (severity 300)
Status bit 3: probe leakage (severity 300)
Status bit 4: clean leakage (severity 300)
Status bit 7: probe memory, file missing (severity 600)
Status bit 9: no probe (severity 600); measurements get Bad_SensorFailure
Status bit 0: capacitance out of range (severity 300)
Status bit 1: conductivity out of range (severity 300)
Status bit 6: FUTURA memory, file missing (severity 600)
Status bit 12: Cole-Cole curve fit error (severity 300)
